counting_rule: Counts describe different survey products, overlap, and must not be summed. No count is a number of validated spatial-3D total-baryon reconstructions.

sources.name: SPARC
sources.role: Baseline rotation curves and baryonic force templates; development exposure must be recorded.
limitations: Derived radial profiles, not spatial 3D maps.
Distance, inclination and stellar mass-to-light assumptions remain.

sources.name: THINGS
sources.role: Resolved atomic-gas morphology and line profiles; local pilot seed.
limitations: HI is not total baryonic density.
Typical physical resolution about 100-500 pc; spectral coordinate is not depth.

sources.name: LITTLE THINGS
limitations: Molecular-gas limits and pressure support are especially consequential.
Survey overlap must be deduplicated.

sources.name: WALLABY Pilot Phase 1
limitations: Nearly 600 detections are not 600 resolved gravity tests.
Its source catalog is also included in DR2.

sources.name: WALLABY Pilot Phase 2
sources.role: Scalable source cubelets, masks, beams and rotation-model checks.
limitations: High-resolution objects overlap the other catalogs.
Marginal resolution and low inclination need injection-based quality tests.
Prefer source cubelets; full footprint cubes are about 0.5 TB each.

sources.name: Apertif DR1
sources.role: Additional HI search volume for source discovery and reprocessing.
limitations: Released line cubes are uncleaned and not primary-beam corrected; required response products are supplied.
The 249672-entry continuum catalog is not an HI galaxy kinematic catalog.
Unique eligible galaxy count requires source finding and quality validation.

sources.name: PHANGS-ALMA
sources.role: CO molecular-gas structure and spectra at roughly cloud scales.
limitations: Survey membership does not guarantee identical delivered products for every object.
CO-to-H2 conversion, CO-dark gas and total-power recovery require explicit treatment.
Approximately 100 pc resolution does not resolve individual stars or unique spatial depth.

sources.name: PHANGS-MUSE
sources.role: Ionized-gas and stellar spectroscopy for independent-tracer comparisons and gas-state constraints.
limitations: Nebulae are not independent galaxies.
Ionized line luminosity is not a direct total gas mass measurement.

sources.name: S4G and early-type extension
limitations: Stellar/nonstellar ICA products are available only for qualifying objects.
Projected light requires uncertain stellar-mass conversion and vertical deprojection.

sources.name: MaNGA DR17
sources.role: Large population and inner stellar/ionized-gas kinematic comparisons, including pressure-supported systems.
limitations: Not 10010 outer-HI rotation curves or spatial-3D mass maps.
Radial coverage, PSF, orbital anisotropy and population modeling differ from HI disk tests.

sources.name: HI-MaNGA DR3
sources.role: Integrated atomic-gas detections or limits for population models.
limitations: Includes nondetections and repeated observations.
Single-dish/integrated HI information does not provide a resolved gas mass map.

sources.name: MIGHTEE-HI / LADUMA 130-galaxy study
sources.role: External survey comparison with resolved HI and baryonic profiles.
limitations: Paper states MIGHTEE cubes and optical/IR inputs are public, while other underlying data are on author request.
Complete access to all 130 derived profiles and LADUMA inputs was not established here.
No author contact was made; paper results have now been seen and exposure must be logged.

sources.name: BIG-SPARC
sources.role: Potential major expansion or reuse of homogenized archive processing.
limitations: The checked description announces work in progress; it does not establish a downloadable completed 4000-object release.
Underlying archives overlap other sources in this registry.
